verdicts.reason: Both use almost the same broken layout. The 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' eyebrow is pinned to the top, far from the 'KIDS BIRTHDAY STUDIO' headline at the bottom, so it reads upside-down in hierarchy. The confetti is shrunk into a tiny strip of specks instead of being spread across the canvas, and the owls sit side by side in the middle with large empty bands above and below. B pulls the owls and headline slightly closer together and leaves a bit more bottom margin, but neither difference is enough to pick a winner.
